title: Plan and usage
description: Read-only limits for the {plan} plan. Existing work remains available if a limit is reduced.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can view plan and usage details.
planNotConfiguredBody: Ask the platform administrator to assign a plan.
effectiveSince: Effective since {date}. New allocations stop at 100%; nothing is deleted automatically.
howLimitsWorkBody: Workspaces cover active brand workspaces. Users include active members and pending administrator invitations. Social profiles have both an agency-wide total and an individual cap for each network. AI requests and tokens reset monthly; storage is cumulative.
requestBody:
Hello,

I'd like to request a limit change for my agency.

Agency name:
Workspace: /app/agency-settings/plan

Current limits / usage: see /app/agency-settings/plan

Reason:
supportRequestsBody: Ticketed asks from a platform administrator to view your agency's content. Approving creates a time-limited grant; rejecting closes the request without a grant.
supportEmptyBody: No platform administrator has filed a support access request for your agency.
supportReviewDescription: Review each platform support request for this agency. Approvals are temporary, scoped, and audited.
supportNoPendingBody: New support access requests for this agency will appear here.
supportDecisionReasonPlaceholder: Explain why you approved or rejected this request.

supportDecisionSuccess.approved: Access approved. The temporary grant is now active.
supportDecisionSuccess.rejected: Request rejected. No access grant was created.

supportDecisionErrors.unauthorized: Your agency access changed. Refresh the page and try again.
supportDecisionErrors.invalid_input: Enter a decision note and try again.
supportDecisionErrors.not_found: This request is not available in the active agency.
supportDecisionErrors.already_decided: This request has already been decided or expired. Refresh the page.
supportDecisionErrors.rate_limited: Too many decisions. Wait briefly and try again.
supportDecisionErrors.decision_failed: Could not save this decision. Try again.
